recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: may along the bay—cool air, clear sky, almost no wind
long spring light: sunrise before six, sunset past eight
headlines skim constellations—labs, rockets, distant capitals—as if through foggy glass
forum static hum around a tempest in the house of a careful star-map
stutter House and melodic techno threading through Swedish pop hooks
repos resting quiet while agents-on-a-phone plots wait in draft

composer-2-fast.concept: Sunglint beads surface on a miniature bay; drag through them before they sink and the water grays out—each catch paints a brighter band on a side spectrogram.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Drag-to-collect ephemeral spark clusters while decoys blink and expire fast.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Thumb drag across the water plane to scoop glints.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: A 45-second round ramps sparkle density so the last ten seconds feel like a sunrise accelerating into song.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Shear gusts shrink hit windows and spawn false shimmers that vanish on contact.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Clear-sky watercolor wash over charcoal water, UI pulse synced to faint four-on-the-floor

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Conduct silence between beats—tap only in the flat gaps of a scrolling stutter waveform; chaining clean hush-hits spikes a multiplier before the lane floods with noise.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Off-beat timing on deliberately empty slots, avoiding bait peaks.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Single-thumb tap on negative space between pulse teeth.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Sixty seconds to chase a perfect ghost chain without missing a hush window.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Fake spikes, shimmer masks, and lane jitter try to bait early taps.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Neon wireframe spectrum, brutalist VU slabs, harsh positive space

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Draw one unbroken fog-line down a folded ridgeline toward the flat city grid—lift your thumb or cross an earlier stroke and the path dissolves.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Continuous path drawing with self-intersection fail.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Finishing a single descent in under a minute peels the fog to a brief clear frame.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Fog thickens and viable corridors narrow; gentle sway mimics offshore marine layer.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Paper-cut hills, milky gradients, muted spring greens and grays

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick sticky-note agents from a bottom dock onto spinning orbit rings—they can stick, bounce, or wobble the stack; stabilize before the stand-up timer ends.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Physics flick with sticky nodes and angular ring motion.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Short directional flick from dock; angle sets arc, speed sets force.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Land five agents without collapse in one minute for a clean scrum badge.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Rings accelerate; random drift vector rotates like a desk fan nudge.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Highlighter yellows, cream stock, clutter-kinetic office surrealism
